# Rest Haven Funeral Home & Memorial Park

Rest Haven Funeral Home & Memorial Park is a Consumer Services company. Rest Haven Funeral Home & Memorial Park employs 8 people (+14.3% YoY, +3 people) and has an annual revenue of $19.7M, founded in 1970. Headquartered in Rockwall, Texas, United States, with offices in Rowlett and Royse City.

## About

The Rest Haven staff serves families of the Lake Ray Hubbard area with funeral arrangements that are compassionate and complete. We have locations in Rockwall, Rowlett, and Royse City. The commitment that sets us apart from other funeral homes in the area is simply this, personalized funeral service.
